name: Sacred City of Kandy
description: Set among green hills in central Sri Lanka, Kandy was the last capital of the island's Sinhalese kings, who held out against Portuguese, Dutch and British rule until 1815. Its heart is the Temple of the Tooth, where a tooth said to be the Buddha's is housed and drawing pilgrims from across the Buddhist world. Visitors come for the temple's rituals and the city's cultural traditions.
